sessionLimitInterruption.handling: The two lenses whose agents errored (wrong-commit, false-green) were re-audited MANUALLY read-only; findings that DID complete (from over-mutation/auth-bypass/transactional/unrelated + the partial false-green) are recorded below.

findings.title: Backup attestation never bound to target or freshness
findings.detail: --attest-backup wrote targetFingerprint/evidenceTimestamp/recordedAtMs but --authorize and --apply checked only backupConfirmed===true; --at was a shape-prefix regex accepting 2026-99-99. A staging-recorded or stale attestation could authorize the production migration (the mutation TARGET was still pinned to EXPECTED, so the wrong DB could not be mutated — but the backup binding was a false assurance).
findings.fix: Added validateBackup(backup,nowMs): requires backup.targetFingerprint===EXPECTED_TARGET_FINGERPRINT, live FINGERPRINT===EXPECTED, recordedAtMs within 24h, and a calendar-valid non-future evidenceTimestamp within 7 days. Wired into --authorize AND --apply. --at now validated via isValidRecentDate (rejects 2026-99-99). emit() derives backupConfirmed from validateBackup, not hardcoded true.

findings.title: Repository-freeze gate was a bare file-existence check
findings.detail: --apply checked only existsSync(STABILITY_FILE); a forged/stale freeze proof, or a source edit after the freeze, would still satisfy it.
findings.fix: Added validateFreezeProof(nowMs): requires frozen===true, treeHashIdenticalABC, contentHashIdenticalABC, recordedAtMs within 24h, migrationChecksum match, AND re-hashes the runner/core/command-center/migration files against the frozen record (FREEZE_SOURCE_CHANGED on any drift). Wired into --apply; emit() derives repositoryStable from it.

findings.title: Committed migration reported FULLY_APPLIED with zero post-commit evidence when certification blocked
findings.detail: deriveE13CommandCenter defaulted p941RemoteStateAfter to FULLY_APPLIED when committed even if postcheck was null/blocked.
findings.fix: Introduced postCertified (committed && postcheck.verdict==='POSTCHECK_COMPLETE'). p941RemoteStateAfter/partnerAfter/compatibility are UNVERIFIABLE unless postCertified. A safety-failed OR absent postcheck now maps to the COMMITTED/POSTCHECK BLOCKED verdict, never a false success or false 'inconsistent'.

findings.title: postMigrationCertify read Result[0] instead of .rows[0] → safety row always undefined → every committed run mis-certified
findings.detail: node-postgres returns a Result object; (await c.query(...))[0] is undefined, so verifySessionSafety(undefined) always failed → POSTCHECK_SAFETY_FAILED on every committed run (false negative, safe but wrong). Happy-path tests missed it because they feed deriveE13CommandCenter synthetic postcheck objects, never the real query result shape.
findings.fix: Changed to (await c.query(...)).rows[0]. Grep confirms no other bare-Result-index remains; all other row reads go through .rows helpers.

wrong-commit.conclusion: No wrong-commit path found. COMMIT requires assertions.allPassed, whose primary gate is classifyP941(postEv).state==='FULLY_APPLIED' — itself fail-closed (needs connected+safetyOk+inspectionComplete + role + 10 tables + columns/indexes + 3 functions + RLS + tenant policies + perimeter grants). A partial migration throws (pg simple-query aborts the batch), is caught, and rolls back. Added p941_detail_present/partner_detail_present assertions so absent detail also fails closed.

false-green.conclusion: Findings #3 and #4 were the false-green defects; both fixed. The command center now yields UNVERIFIABLE-after-commit + POSTCHECK BLOCKED whenever certification did not run to completion, and the hard-value guard (buildE13CommandCenter) refuses production/deployment/payout true and mutated-without-commit.

otherLensesClean.transactional-safety: confirmed fully transactional on PG17 (0 CONCURRENTLY/VACUUM/CREATE EXTENSION/CREATE DATABASE; CREATE ROLE in DO block rolls back cleanly).
otherLensesClean.unrelated-schema-damage: migration touches only clonechat_* + clonechat_app; partner_preserved assertion (classifyPartnerPayout===FULLY_APPLIED) is a commit gate; search_path=public + schema-qualified sweep; no CREATE OR REPLACE of an existing non-clonechat function.

verdict: All 4 confirmed findings fixed and regression-tested; 2 session-limited lenses re-audited manually with no residual defect.
